request.project_task: Create a restaurant table reservation service.
request.project_goal: Accept reservations while respecting table capacity.
request.project_description: A guest requests a table; staff can confirm, modify, or cancel reservations.

functional_requirements.text: A guest searches available times for party size and date.

atoms.text: A guest searches available times for party size and date.

functional_requirements.text: A guest submits contact details to reserve a table.

atoms.text: A guest submits contact details to reserve a table.

functional_requirements.text: The system prevents reservations above available capacity.

atoms.text: The system prevents reservations above available capacity.

functional_requirements.text: Staff can modify an existing reservation.

atoms.text: Staff can modify an existing reservation.

functional_requirements.text: Staff can cancel an existing reservation.

atoms.text: Staff can cancel an existing reservation.

non_functional_requirements.text: Contact details must not be displayed to unauthorized staff roles.

actors.name: Guest
actors.description: A person who wants to reserve a table at the restaurant.

use_cases.name: Search Available Times
use_cases.goal: Guest finds available reservation times for a given party size and date.
use_cases.trigger: Guest wants to reserve a table and needs to see available times.

preconditions.text: The restaurant has a defined capacity and operating hours.

success_postconditions.text: Guest is presented with a list of available times for the requested party size and date.

failure_postconditions.text: Guest is informed that no times are available or the request is invalid.

steps.action: Guest enters party size and date.
System checks table availability against capacity.
System displays available times to the guest.
steps.expected_result: Guest sees a list of available times.

steps.action: System finds no available times for the requested party size and date.
steps.expected_result: System informs the guest that no times are available.

user_stories.capability: search for available reservation times by party size and date
user_stories.benefit: I can find a suitable time to reserve a table.

system_stories.responsibility: Ensure that only times with sufficient capacity are shown.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-001 — Search Available Times
Goal: Guest finds available reservation times for a given party size and date.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Guest wants to reserve a table and needs to see available times.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC001-001: The restaurant has a defined capacity and operating hours.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC001-001] Guest enters party size and date.
  2. [STEP-UC001-002] System checks table availability against capacity.
  3. [STEP-UC001-003] System displays available times to the guest.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC001-EXC-001: No availability
Source FRs: FR-001, FR-003

use_cases.name: Submit Reservation
use_cases.goal: Guest reserves a table by providing contact details.
use_cases.trigger: Guest selects an available time and proceeds to reserve.

preconditions.text: Guest has selected an available time slot.

success_postconditions.text: Reservation is created and confirmed to the guest.

failure_postconditions.text: Reservation is not created; guest is informed of the failure.

steps.action: Guest provides contact details (name, phone, email).
System validates contact details and checks capacity again.
steps.expected_result: Details are valid and capacity is available.

steps.action: System creates the reservation and sends confirmation.
System detects that the requested time is no longer available due to capacity.
steps.expected_result: System informs the guest that the reservation cannot be made.

user_stories.capability: submit my contact details to reserve a table
user_stories.benefit: I can secure a table at my chosen time.

system_stories.system_action: Validate contact details and enforce capacity limits
system_stories.responsibility: Prevent overbooking and ensure valid contact information.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-002 — Submit Reservation
Goal: Guest reserves a table by providing contact details.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Guest selects an available time and proceeds to reserve.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC002-001: Guest has selected an available time slot.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC002-001] Guest provides contact details (name, phone, email).
  2. [STEP-UC002-002] System validates contact details and checks capacity again.
  3. [STEP-UC002-003] System creates the reservation and sends confirmation.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC002-EXC-001: Capacity exceeded
Source FRs: FR-002, FR-003

use_cases.name: Modify Reservation
use_cases.trigger: Staff needs to change details of an existing reservation.

preconditions.text: A reservation exists and staff has access to modify it.

success_postconditions.text: Reservation is updated with new details.

failure_postconditions.text: Reservation remains unchanged; staff is informed of the failure.

steps.action: Staff selects an existing reservation to modify.
System validates changes against capacity and updates the reservation.
System detects that the modified reservation would exceed capacity.
steps.expected_result: System rejects the modification and informs staff.

user_stories.benefit: I can accommodate changes requested by guests.

system_stories.responsibility: Ensure modifications do not exceed available capacity.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-003 — Modify Reservation
Goal: Staff modifies an existing reservation.
Primary actor: ACT-002
Trigger: Staff needs to change details of an existing reservation.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC003-001: A reservation exists and staff has access to modify it.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC003-001] Staff selects an existing reservation to modify.
  2. [STEP-UC003-002] Staff enters updated reservation details.
  3. [STEP-UC003-003] System validates changes against capacity and updates the reservation.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC003-EXC-001: Modification violates capacity
Source FRs: FR-004, FR-003

use_cases.name: Cancel Reservation
use_cases.trigger: Staff needs to cancel a reservation.

preconditions.text: A reservation exists and staff has access to cancel it.

success_postconditions.text: Reservation is cancelled and capacity is freed.

failure_postconditions.text: Reservation remains active; staff is informed of the failure.

steps.action: Staff selects an existing reservation to cancel.
System cancels the reservation and updates availability.
steps.expected_result: Reservation is cancelled and capacity is freed.

user_stories.benefit: I can free up tables for other guests.

system_stories.responsibility: Ensure capacity is correctly adjusted after cancellation.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-004 — Cancel Reservation
Goal: Staff cancels an existing reservation.
Primary actor: ACT-002
Trigger: Staff needs to cancel a reservation.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC004-001: A reservation exists and staff has access to cancel it.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC004-001] Staff selects an existing reservation to cancel.
  2. [STEP-UC004-002] Staff confirms cancellation.
  3. [STEP-UC004-003] System cancels the reservation and updates availability.
Source FRs: FR-005, FR-003
